verdict.line: You lose if you trade single hits into a recharged Granite Shield or get caught by R (Unstoppable Force) after level 6; you win if you survive to two items and force extended skirmishes where Duelist stacking and R (Blade Waltz) outlast his armor.

brief.thesis: Malphite's Passive (Granite Shield) eats single pokes and his Q (Seismic Shard) outranges your melee kit at 625 vs. your Q (Lunge)'s 600, so isolated trades favor him early, which is why Fiora sits at 44.5% over 2,718 games here against lane/solo-kill advantage Malphite. Fiora's entire kit is built around sustained multi-hit trades — Passive (Duelist) stacks on repeated strikes — so the matchup inverts once you can stack damage faster than his shield recharges and his armor stops scaling ahead of your build.

theirWindow.when: W (Brutal Strikes) active and shield up
theirWindow.what: He's hitting harder and tankier than normal — his attacks hit everything in front of him and his AD/Armor are both spiked. Disengage or parry with W (Riposte) rather than trading autos.

yourWindow.when: his shield is broken, W/E on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Commit with Q (Lunge) and autos to stack Passive (Duelist) for sustain — his W (Brutal Strikes) and E (Ground Slam) are both down so he can't spike damage or cut your attack speed mid-trade.

start.why: Highest pick rate (68.1%) start for this matchup — the AD and sustain help you win short trades before his shield recharges.

boots.why: Malphite's Q (Seismic Shard) and E (Ground Slam) are both magic damage, and the tenacity cuts the slow from Q and the stun duration setup around his R (Unstoppable Force).

core.why: Cleave damage and lifesteal feed Passive (Duelist) stacking in skirmishes, the single highest-winrate path at 51.2% over 404 games.
Spellblade burst plus move speed lets you close the gap his Q poke opened and punish the moment his shield is down.
Converts the burst from his R engage and E (Ground Slam) poke into delayed damage you can heal through with Passive (Duelist).

runes.keystoneWhy: This page measures 48.6% winrate (versus 40.6% for the Grasp page) by rewarding the exact extended-skirmish, stack-up-damage pattern that breaks through Malphite's Passive (Granite Shield) and rising armor. Master-tier Fiora players instead run Press the Attack (Precision) across 13,801 games — that suits players who win short, decisive trades rather than long skirmishes, so take it if you're the type to end fights fast rather than grind them out.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the standard pick (70.9% pick rate) and lets you punish Malphite's lack of a dash — he can't escape a committed all-in before level 6. Flash+Teleport (25.9% pick) is the better call if you're planning to abuse the level 12+ split-push window instead of forcing lane kills.

playing.title: Bait, don't eat, his Q
playing.detail: Q (Seismic Shard) has an 8s cooldown and 625 range, just past your Q (Lunge)'s 600. Stand at the edge of his range so he has to overextend to land it, then punish the 8s window after he throws it.

playing.title: Save W for his all-in, not for poke
playing.detail: Per the matchup read, hold W (Riposte) in reserve rather than popping it for the AD buff on a random trade — the parry is far more valuable shutting down his empowered W (Brutal Strikes) auto or a post-R follow-up auto.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Unstoppable Force
playing.detail: R (Unstoppable Force) is 1000 range with only a 130/115/100/80/80s cooldown rotation — it can catch you from well outside normal trading range. Don't overextend past minions once he hits 6.

playing.title: Don't trade right after his Ground Slam
playing.detail: E (Ground Slam) cuts attack speed for a short duration, which directly guts your E (Burst of Speed) and Passive (Duelist) stacking. Wait out the attack-speed reduction before committing your own cooldowns.

playing.title: Break the shield before you commit
playing.detail: A single Lunge poke into a recharged Passive (Granite Shield) just gets absorbed. Soften him with an auto first, then land your real trade (E active, autos stacking) so it hits full damage.

playing.title: Use R to shred through rising armor
playing.detail: R (Blade Waltz) lands multiple dashing strikes on him; even though successive hits on the same target deal reduced damage, the repeated instances still outpace what single autos can do against his stacking armor from W (Brutal Strikes).

playing.title: Push side lanes once you're two items up
playing.detail: After Hydra and Trinity Force you out-scale him in any extended fight — use that window to pressure side lanes rather than force risky top-lane all-ins into his shield and R.

brief.patchCaveat: The build paths, rune pages, boots, summoners, and every win rate above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1, 2,718-game Fiora-vs-Malphite sample); the trade timing, shield-breaking, and cooldown-based tactical reads are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Always be careful of Malphite’s (R) after reaching level 6. Keep [W] in reserve and try to hit [P] while fighting him.
